title: Sentai Strike
description: A color-squad hero brawler inspired by classic Japanese sentai shows. Swap between three heroes, rescue citizens that grunts try to carry away, hold the city until the monster appears, then beat it with your team finisher. When it grows giant, pilot the Sentai Robo, but every attack you dodge lands on the city, so guard to save the buildings. 7 bosses, tag combos, directional specials, a secret fourth hero, a daily mash-up Monster of the Day and your own squad name and catchphrase.
